messages.subject: Re: [CorpLing with R] Rstudio Issue?
parts:
You have to give it the package you want to install, e.g. install.packages("ggplot2"). It's not an RStudio issue.

By the way, in general you can use "?" followed by command to read the docs. For example, typing in ?install.packages shows that it is expecting a character vector "pkgs" which are the packages you want to install. A single string is also a character vector, as may be verified by class() and is.vector().
